author: Karl Rock
description:
How long should a taxi driver have to wait for a passenger to pay?

A taxi driver in Karachi, Pakistan, told me about a passenger who changed her route, disputed the fare, and then kept him waiting for 20–25 minutes after reaching her destination.

He says he even paid a 70-rupee expressway toll out of his own pocket to get her there faster! But instead of paying promptly, she asked him to drive to an ATM and continued making him wait.

The driver was furious because every minute spent waiting meant losing time he could have spent earning money from another passenger.

Who was in the wrong here?
title: The Passenger Who Wasted 25 Minutes!

author: Karl Rock
description:
Are ride-hailing companies in Pakistan doing enough to protect their drivers and passengers?

While travelling through Karachi, my taxi driver started telling me about the problems he faces on the job. He complained that ride-hailing companies take their commission but offer little support when disputes happen between drivers and passengers.

He even claimed the company deducted its commission before he'd started his car!

He acknowledges there are bad drivers as well as bad passengers, but believes the companies should take more responsibility for everyone's safety.

Do you think taxi apps do enough to protect their drivers?
title: Do Taxi Apps Protect Their Drivers?
